messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on API ingress — brief spike of 502/504s. Region: eu-west-1. Start: 2024-06-10T03:33:27Z. Rolling anomaly window 90s. https://health.example/alerts/1728600007

maria (on-call): seeing it, joining. oncall running.

sam (sre): confirmed — most failures are 502 upstream resets and a subset 504 timeouts. Thundering pattern from a handful of clients but overall fanout at edge is high.

jon (platform): checking connection pools on the ingress mux. quick `curl` to metrics endpoint: `GET /metrics?svc=ingress-mux` shows `conn_pool_in_use=990` / `conn_pool_max=1000` for eu-west-1.

sam (sre): that matches logs — upstream is returning `RST` from p50 of connections. snippet from edge logs:
```
2024-06-10T03:33:22Z ingress-edge-12: upstream reset from 10.4.12.8:443 while proxying /v1/generate
2024-06-10T03:33:23Z ingress-edge-07: 504 gateway timeout to backend modelsvc-eu-0
2024-06-10T03:33:23Z ingress-edge-12: 502 upstream connection reset
```

maria (on-call): impact? error rate pct and any customer-facing endpoints? diane, can you pull support triage numbers?

diane (support): quick look from observability: ~12% of total requests for the last 2 mins in eu-west-1 failed with 5xx. A few high-volume customers show retries in logs, one customer (acct: acme-beta) sees ~40% errors on `POST /v1/chat` over last minute.

jon (platform): I can flip fallback routing at the traffic-router for eu-west -> eu-central for non-sticky traffic to reduce fanout. Recommend temporary traffic shift for 20% and reduce new connections to the overloaded pool. Anyone object?

sam (sre): +1 for partial shift. Also throttle long-polling and reduce multiplex window to free up sockets. Command to reduce mux keepalive: `kubectl patch configmap ingress-mux --patch '{"data":{"keepalive_max_idle": "30s"}}'` — but that's risky. Maybe do traffic shift first.

maria (on-call): start traffic shift canary 20% now, monitor for error drop and pool relief. @jon please run the shift and post status. I'll coordinate oncall and customer comms.

jon (platform): executing traffic-router change: `trafficctl route set --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1 --percent 20 --selector '!sticky'`
jon (platform): response: OK -> change applied (id=tr-change-1728600007). Rolling now. :white_check_mark:

sam (sre): seeing connection pool in_use down to 840 within 30s. 5xx rate trending down from 12% -> 6% in the canary window.

diane (support): drafted a short customer update for affected accounts: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors in EU. We have enacted routing mitigations and are monitoring. We'll update in 15 minutes." Want me to send now?

maria (on-call): yes send to customers flagged with >20% error. Add that we have a mitigation in place (traffic shift) and that we're tracking impact.

diane (support): sent. ticket updates posted. :mailbox_with_mail:

sam (sre): note — some nodes in modelsvc-eu-0 show `accept queue full` in runtime logs. possible slow downstream or GC plateau. We'll open a follow-up to investigate model infra.

jon (platform): also toggled multiplex backpressure thresholds: `ingress.mux.max_streams=500` -> lowered to 300 to reduce head-of-line impact. Applied and observed immediate drop in new streams.

maria (on-call): summary for incident channel: short 5xx spike eu-west-1 (502/504) likely root cause: downstream model instance saturation + connection pool exhaustion. Mitigation: 20% traffic shift to eu-central for non-sticky traffic + lowered mux streams + support notifications. Current status: 5xx rate reduced to ~4% and still trending down.

sam (sre): agree with summary. recommending next actions: 1) autoscale review for modelsvc-eu-0, 2) postmortem if regression confirmed, 3) consider longer-term increase of conn_pool_max or smarter per-tenant limits.

maria (on-call): starting incident timeline doc. I'll escalate to SEV2 for follow-up. Assigning owners: sam for root-cause triage, jon for routing/ingress config remediation, diane for customer comms.

incident-bot: Pager escalation: SEV2 declared, primary oncall @maria paged. Escalation policy engaged at 03:34:05Z.

maria (on-call): thanks team. keep logs clipped and post any regression. I'll reopen channel if we need a war room. Otherwise let's monitor for stabilization for 30m then demote. :thumbsup:

jon (platform): baseline metrics after change: conn_pool_in_use=420 / conn_pool_max=1000, 5xx eu-west-1=3.9%, P95 latency improved 120ms -> 95ms.

sam (sre): logging some followups in the incident doc: potential causes: GC pause on model nodes, upstream NLB transient, or traffic fanout causing queueing. Will correlate model logs + node CPU.

diane (support): customers been notified and support queue flagged high-priority. No major escalations yet.

maria (on-call): closing this live triage thread — mitigation holding and oncall owners assigned for post-incident. Will update with the postmortem link when ready. :lock_with_key:
